span.p:
Source: DataDescription_ParseFlagStr is a pure table walk
with single direct assignment (*pOutFlags = table_entry[1]).
No post-OR step; each keyword resolves to its exact bit value.
Audit Appendix A confirmed the full 16-entry table
(9 primary entries shown here + 7 deprecated aliases not shown).
CLIENT_ONLY is NOT in the parsed-keyword surface.
